gen-audiowide-gf-julius-sans-one: Futuristic tiles with wide grout lines: Audiowide stands tall, while Julius Sans One scatters its letters across generous blank space. That sans body reads loose and unhurried, even across many lines.
gen-dafont-jelly-crazies-fs-ranade: Wide-spaced and gently swelling, the sans-serif text here reads like stretched rubber cord, barely flexing. Ranade is best at open, spread-out lines, while Jelly Crazies is best at closed, wobbly outlines.
gen-eater-gf-julius-sans-one: Open-ended on every curve, the sans-serif text drifts through wide stretches of blank space. Julius Sans One against Eater makes the sharpest hit: quiet one-width outlines facing a dark, aggressive heading.
gen-eater-gf-lexend-exa: Dark and aggressive, Eater tops the pair with wide gaps between its letters. Lexend Exa then reads smoothly, its big x-height and wide-open curves keeping each word distinct line after line.
gen-dafont-groovy-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Groovy squeezes its c almost shut and spaces its lowercase loosely, a friendly bit of funk. And Be Vietnam Pro keeps its curve endings well apart, so text flows smoothly down the page.
gen-flavors-gf-cascadia-code: Chunky pencil strokes: Flavors towers with whimsical weight. Cascadia Code runs thin as wire, with generous gaps between neighbors and smooth bends, so a line of text glides along without snagging.
gen-dafont-starborn-fs-merriweather-sans: Merriweather Sans brings tall, large-looking lowercase and a clearly open e. Dreamy Starborn, wide-gapped with a thick dark lowercase band, floats overhead, and that sturdiness underneath is the whole appeal.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-cascadia-code: Cascadia Code is wire-like, with generous gaps between neighbors, while Autour One makes bold, expressive display shapes. Autour One announces loudly, while Cascadia Code carries smooth lines of text.
gen-gf-autour-one-gf-cascadia-mono: Standing like pins in a wide board, the Cascadia Mono letters read compact and modern. And Autour One, bold and expressive, takes the headline spot with barely any step from capital to lowercase.
gen-fs-new-title-gf-hanuman: Links in a fine chain: New Title locks its tall-lowercase letters together, bold and modern. And Hanuman, traditional and refined with a high-waisted lowercase, does the quieter work of carrying the text.
